//: A Hosting release whose only job is to stop serving the old app. See ./README.md — in particular, do not deploy it while cfp.gdgmontreal.com is still served by Hosting.

hosting.//public: Relative to this file, not to the directory deploy is run from — --config makes the config's own directory the project root. Nothing in it is ever served: the catch-all below is evaluated before static files, so a file here would be shadowed. It exists because the CLI requires the key.

redirects.//: The root, separately. A capture of /:rest* does not match / — deployed without this, the bare .web.app address 404s, which is the one address most people have.
301, not 302: this is permanent, and a search engine holding the .web.app copy should transfer it to the canonical origin rather than keep both.
redirects.//2: Firebase glob captures are named — :rest* is the multi-segment one. :splat is Netlify's and would be emitted literally, sending every visitor to a path called ':splat*'.
